pipeline_stages.name: Outreach
pipeline_stages.guidance_md: We contacted them. Follow up within 48h. Log channel and contact responses.
exit_checklist: Sent initial personalized note or message

pipeline_stages.name: Engaged
pipeline_stages.guidance_md: Client replied or inbound came in. Send discovery questionnaire or book a 15-min discovery triage.
exit_checklist: Offered discovery questionnaire or intro call

pipeline_stages.name: Discovery
pipeline_stages.guidance_md: Questionnaire sent or returned, requirements being captured. Review answers and synthesize AI brief.

pipeline_stages.name: Sampling: Building
pipeline_stages.guidance_md: Free sample in progress. Build working prototype using asset templates. Log hours spent in sampling costs.

pipeline_stages.name: Sampling: Review
pipeline_stages.guidance_md: Ask if they are happy. Record a score. Score 4 or 5: create a quote or offer an add-on. Score 3 or below: log the changes they want and create a build task.

pipeline_stages.name: Proposal
pipeline_stages.guidance_md: Quote sent. Track view events. Follow up after 48h. Check valid_until expiration date.

pipeline_stages.name: Won: Building
pipeline_stages.guidance_md: Paid build in progress. Execute Build Brief. Build live deliverables, link GitHub/hosted URLs, track hours.

pipeline_stages.name: Delivered
pipeline_stages.guidance_md: Live and handed over. Send handover documentation, repo access, and request testimonial rating.
exit_checklist: Asset usage logged for reused templates

pipeline_stages.name: Growth
pipeline_stages.guidance_md: Upsell and expansion offers. Run product relations recommendations to propose workflows or chatbots.

pipeline_stages.name: Lost
pipeline_stages.guidance_md: Terminal stage. Requires lost_reason. Nurture for re-engagement in 6 months.

pipeline_stages.name: Paused / Nurture
pipeline_stages.guidance_md: On hold due to client timing or budget. Set reminder task for periodic check-in.

questionnaires.ai_summary: Apex Logistics operates 45 regional freight vehicles in Gauteng. Drivers lose 15-20 min per stop coordinating waybills via voice calls. Key goal is zero-touch WhatsApp dispatch when a vehicle enters the geofence. Budget R20,000-R35,000. Sample success criteria: working WhatsApp message with dynamic manifest PDF.

answers.q1: Long-haul freight and temperature-controlled FMCG distribution in Southern Africa.
answers.q2: Eliminate manual driver coordination calls and send automatic WhatsApp delivery links upon depot departure.
answers.q3: Dispatch controller (1 person) and 45 company drivers.
answers.q4: Fleet management telematics (Mix Telematics), Google Sheets, and WhatsApp.
answers.q5: Dispatchers manually phone each driver with route changes, leading to errors and delays.
answers.q8: A test driver getting an automated WhatsApp with the correct delivery stops and one-click Google Maps link.

feedback.comments: The sample WhatsApp dispatch worked instantly on our test vehicle. Team loved the clear route link.
feedback.requested_changes: Can we also add a button for the driver to confirm arrival at destination?

sampling_costs.note: Initial prototype build and WhatsApp template registration
